title: How I Fight GLP-1 Fatigue: My Personal Energy Stack & Recovery Case Study
My 46-Pound Transformation: Stacking Tirzepatide with an OTC Energy Blueprint
Tirzepatide & Beyond: The OTC Supplement Stack I Use to Rebuild My Body
description:
In this video, I share my personal case study on how I optimized my energy levels and cellular performance while on a metabolic protocol. I have lost 46 pounds (starting at 258 lbs, now holding at 212 lbs), and in this deep dive, I explain why I pivot away from caffeine or heavy stimulants and stack over-the-counter mitochondrial cofactors to keep my focus and daily output high.

We cover the science of Tirzepatide dosing (the 5-day cadence), the dual-stage mitochondrial pump of L-Carnitine and CoQ10, and how I protect my muscles against sarcopenia with creatine and whey protein. I also explain why I cycled off my joint-healing peptides (BPC-157 & TB-500) to allow my shoulder and pituitary receptors to naturally reset.

Read the full blog post and detail sheets: https://keystonerecomposition.com
